title: MZ Aetheria - A Journey in the Making

posts.author: AshMage
posts.body:
I’ve just posted the prototype of my game, Aetheria. It’s very much a work in progress, and I’m not sure where this journey will lead. There are plenty of bugs and unfinished parts, but I’m giving it my best because RPGs have always been a huge part of my life. Games like Shining Force and Phantasy Star shaped my love for the genre, and I’ve always dreamed of making an RPG of my own.
That said, this is my first attempt at game development, and I’ve got a long way to go. Time, money, and my limited knowledge are definite challenges, but I’m at least taking a shot at it. It’s still very early—maybe 1-2% done—but I’m putting it out there.
Aetheria tells the story of a young man forced to leave his village after a mysterious encounter with a dangerous monster. To protect his home and his beloved mother, he sets out on a journey that will lead him into a larger world filled with challenges, friendships, and discovery.
The game will include features such as:
Friendship Skills: Build bonds with characters to unlock special abilities and interactions.
Pet System: Adopt and train pets to assist you on your journey.
Crafting: Gather materials to create useful items and gear.
Guilds: Join different guilds to learn unique skills and shape your character’s path.
While some of these features have already been implemented, I’m still figuring out when and how to introduce them in the game. Since this is my first major project, and I’m unsure how well it will be received, I’m balancing the timing and depth of these mechanics to make the experience enjoyable for players.
Please give it a try and let me know what you think. Your feedback would mean a lot and help me decide whether to keep pushing forward.
